title: MathSmith: Towards Extremely Hard Mathematical Reasoning by Forging Synthetic Problems with a Reinforced Policy
authors_zh: Shaoxiong Zhan、Yanlin Lai、Ziyu Lu、Dahua Lin、Ziqing Yang、Fei Tan
paper_type_zh: 强化式困难数学数据构建与开放发布
best_for_zh: 研究合成难题、数据生成 RL、难度奖励、长 CoT 与弱点定向训练的读者
one_line: Trains and releases Qwen3-8B problem synthesizers that turn PlanetMath-derived concepts into rationales and hard math problems using structural, trace-length, and same-teacher consistency rewards.
MathSmith 用 PlanetMath 衍生概念训练并发布 Qwen3-8B 出题器，以结构、教师推理长度和同教师答案一致性奖励生成题目与构造 rationale；这些信号仍不是独立数学验证。
why: It exposes a reusable generator-side SFT-to-GRPO pipeline and intermediate data objects while showing that its difficulty and availability signals remain teacher-dependent proxies rather than independent mathematical verification.
inclusion_reason: An open concept-to-problem construction pipeline with generator code, HC/Hard synthesizers, problem/rationale records, solution traces, and downstream models, plus explicit multi-objective rewards whose correctness and lineage limits remain auditable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MathSmith addresses a data-construction bottleneck: difficult mathematical training questions are scarce, while many synthesis pipelines mutate existing benchmark-like problems and inherit their templates. It instead begins with mathematics pages from PlanetMath, filters non-concept entries, and uses GPT-4o to create about 11,000 concept-explanation-category records. A generation prompt samples five such records, allows the model to select a meaningful subset of at least two concepts, and requires at least two of nine difficulty strategies.

The released primary object is not only a question. HC and Hard problem records contain the sampled concepts, a construction rationale, and the final problem; companion releases attach Qwen3-30B-A3B short- or long-CoT solutions. This makes the work relevant to the data-construction and open-release-recipes track: it exposes prompt sourcing, generator training, reward design, released policies, intermediate problem/rationale records, and solution traces. It does not, however, provide one immutable manifest that joins each PlanetMath page, generated candidate, reward decision, retained problem, solution, and downstream training example.

MathSmith 针对一个数据构造瓶颈：高难度数学训练题稀缺，而许多合成流程从现有基准风格题目出发做改写，因而继承其模板。该方法改从 PlanetMath 数学页面起步，过滤非概念条目，再用 GPT-4o 构造约 11,000 条“概念—解释—类别”记录。每个生成提示随机抽取五条记录，允许模型选择至少两个可自然结合的概念，并要求使用九种难度策略中的至少两种。

公开的核心对象不只是题目。HC 和 Hard 题目记录包含 sampled_concept、构造 rationale 与最终 problem；配套发布再附上 Qwen3-30B-A3B 生成的短 CoT 或长 CoT 解答。因此，该工作与“数据构造与开放发布配方”轨道直接相关：它公开了提示来源、生成器训练、奖励设计、策略权重、中间题目/rationale 记录和解答轨迹。但目前没有一份不可变 manifest，把每个 PlanetMath 页面、生成候选、奖励决定、保留题目、解答和下游训练样本完整连接起来。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central design choice is to train the data generator itself. GPT-4o first produces about 8,000 cold-start examples, each structured as a five-step construction rationale plus one focused problem. Qwen3-8B learns this format through LoRA SFT. GRPO then optimizes two variants: MathSmith-HC combines structural, reasoning-complexity, and answer-consistency signals; MathSmith-Hard removes the consistency term to emphasize the trace-length proxy.

Structural reward checks for the required rationale and problem XML-style spans and rewards exactly five rationale steps, with weights 0.7 and 0.3. Complexity is the average length of K teacher reasoning traces divided by a maximum-length constant. Consistency is 1 when a strict majority of the same teacher's extracted answers agree, otherwise 0; the reasoning reward weights complexity 0.7 and consistency 0.3. These are generator rewards, not proofs. Long traces may reflect difficulty, verbosity, or confusion, and same-teacher agreement can repeat the same error.

Concept provenance also supports a weakness-focused loop: generate a Practice Set, detect target-model errors, trace them back to concept sets, create aligned variants, fine-tune, and iterate until an accuracy threshold is reached.

核心设计是直接训练数据生成器。GPT-4o 先生成约 8,000 条冷启动样本，每条由五步构造 rationale 和一个聚焦题目组成；Qwen3-8B 通过 LoRA SFT 学习该格式。随后，GRPO 优化两个版本：MathSmith-HC 同时使用结构、推理复杂度和答案一致性信号；MathSmith-Hard 删除一致性项，更强调推理长度代理。

结构奖励检查所要求的 rationale 与 problem XML 风格区段，并鼓励 rationale 恰有五步，格式与步数权重分别为 0.7 和 0.3。复杂度是 K 条教师推理轨迹的平均长度除以最大长度常量。一致性在同一教师的抽取答案出现严格多数时为 1，否则为 0；推理奖励对复杂度与一致性的权重为 0.7 和 0.3。这些是训练出题器的奖励，不是数学证明。较长轨迹可能来自难度、冗长或困惑，同教师多数也可能重复同一个错误。

概念 provenance 还支撑弱点定向循环：生成 Practice Set，识别目标模型错误，追溯对应概念集合，生成同概念变体，微调并迭代，直到达到预设准确率阈值。

title: Method
方法
html:
The source stage crawls PlanetMath mathematics pages, removes pages judged unrelated to mathematical concepts, and asks GPT-4o to extract concepts, short explanations grounded in each page, and one to three broad categories. For cold-start construction, five records are sampled. The prompt requires one unified, non-proof question with a numeric, symbolic, expression, or equation answer; it also requires at least two difficulty strategies among multi-step reasoning, cross-topic integration, reverse logic, distractors, abstract modeling, multiple solution paths, advanced manipulation, extreme conditions, and non-standard representation.

The paper reports LoRA rank 16 SFT for five epochs on 8 H100 GPUs, followed by GRPO with MathSmith-SFT as reference. Reward-time complexity and consistency use K=5 Qwen3-30B-A3B samples; the structural and reasoning weights are 0.7/0.3; policy and teacher inference use 20 H100 GPUs; the selected checkpoint is step 100. Downstream baselines are trained for five epochs with LLaMA-Factory at learning rate 1e-5.

The current repository is useful but not an exact run manifest. Its example GRPO script uses rollout group size 6, while its reward code defaults to three teacher samples, maximum generation length 32,768, and temperature 0.3; its SFT YAML uses eight epochs. These differ from the paper's K=5, 20-GPU, five-epoch account. The release therefore establishes an executable scaffold, but the exact published configuration remains partly unknown.

Problem datasets expose sampled_concept, rationale, and problem fields; solution datasets expose problem, answer, optional answer_dict/highest_freq, and sampled_concept. The checked pages provide a single train split without stable cross-release IDs.

源数据阶段抓取 PlanetMath 数学页面，移除与数学概念无关的页面，并要求 GPT-4o 从页面中抽取概念、简要解释以及一至三个大类。冷启动构造时随机抽取五条记录。提示要求生成一个目标统一、非证明式、可用数值、符号、表达式或方程回答的题目；同时至少使用两种难度策略：多步推理、跨主题整合、逆向逻辑、干扰条件、抽象建模、多种解法、高级变换、极端条件或非标准表示。

论文报告：Qwen3-8B 先以 LoRA rank 16 在 8 张 H100 上做五个 epoch 的 SFT；随后以 MathSmith-SFT 为 reference 做 GRPO。奖励阶段对复杂度和一致性均使用 K=5 个 Qwen3-30B-A3B 样本，结构与推理内部权重均为 0.7/0.3；策略与教师推理合计使用 20 张 H100，最终选择第 100 步 checkpoint。下游 baseline 通过 LLaMA-Factory 以学习率 1e-5 训练五个 epoch。

当前仓库有复用价值，但不是论文原始运行的精确 manifest。其 GRPO 示例脚本把 rollout group 设为 6，奖励代码默认教师样本数为 3、最大生成长度为 32,768、温度为 0.3，而 SFT YAML 使用八个 epoch；这些设置与论文的 K=5、20 GPU、五 epoch 叙述不同。因此，发布物证明了存在可执行 scaffold，但论文运行配置仍有部分未知。

题目数据集公开 sampled_concept、rationale 和 problem；解答数据集公开 problem、answer、可选的 answer_dict/highest_freq 与 sampled_concept。所检查页面只有一个 train split，且没有稳定的跨发布 ID。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
In the controlled 50K comparisons reported in Table 1, MathSmith-HC has the highest average score on the three hard benchmarks under the tested short- and long-CoT students. Under long-CoT training, the project page reports a hard-benchmark average of 71.8 for Qwen3-8B and 51.0 for DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, corresponding to the authors' reported relative gains of 9.8% and 15.6%. These results support the tested training recipes; they do not by themselves validate every generated record.

The construction ablation in Table 3 is more directly informative. After generating 50K problems per variant, Available Ratio—defined as correctly formatted and teacher-solvable with a valid answer—is 71.50% for MathSmith-SFT, 84.92% for MathSmith-Hard, and 95.38% for MathSmith-HC. MathSmith-HC and MathSmith-Hard both report 36.6 average hard-benchmark accuracy in that table. The consistency term therefore improves this teacher-dependent availability measure without establishing independent correctness.

Figure 4 reports that MathSmith-HC remains ahead of NuminaMath-COT and OpenMathInstruct-2 as training volume grows from 50K to 200K on OlympiadBench. Figure 5 reports smaller or negative effects for 1.7B and 4B students but clearer gains for larger Qwen3 models. In the weakness-focused experiment, 1,000 Practice Set problems receive 32 Qwen3-30B-A3B completions, 923 remain after filtering, and concept-targeted variants outperform random variants in the authors' reported evaluation.

Release inspection also reveals a cautionary counterexample: the LongCoT viewer includes a solution trace that notices missing or inconsistent definitions, makes assumptions, and still guesses a boxed answer. Public availability makes such audits possible, but it also shows why teacher solvability and majority agreement are not equivalent to mathematical validity.

在表 1 的 50K 对照实验中，MathSmith-HC 在所测试的短 CoT 与长 CoT 学生模型上取得最高的三个困难基准平均分。项目页报告，在长 CoT 训练下，Qwen3-8B 的困难基准平均分为 71.8，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 为 51.0；作者给出的相对提升分别为 9.8% 和 15.6%。这些结果支持相应训练配方，但不能单独验证每条生成记录。

表 3 的构造消融更直接。每个版本生成 50K 题目后，Available Ratio——定义为格式正确且教师可给出有效答案——在 MathSmith-SFT、MathSmith-Hard 和 MathSmith-HC 上分别为 71.50%、84.92% 和 95.38%。同一表中，MathSmith-HC 与 MathSmith-Hard 的困难基准平均准确率均为 36.6。因此，一致性项提高了这个依赖教师的可用率指标，却没有提供独立正确性证明。

图 4 报告，训练量从 50K 扩展到 200K 时，MathSmith-HC 在 OlympiadBench 上仍领先 NuminaMath-COT 与 OpenMathInstruct-2。图 5 显示，1.7B 和 4B 学生的收益更小或为负，而更大的 Qwen3 模型收益更清晰。弱点定向实验中，1,000 个 Practice Set 题目各生成 32 个 Qwen3-30B-A3B completion，过滤后保留 923 条；作者报告概念定向变体优于随机变体。

发布物检查也给出反例：LongCoT viewer 中存在一条解答轨迹，它先指出定义缺失或题目不一致，随后仍作假设并猜测 boxed answer。公开发布使这种审计成为可能，同时也证明“教师可解”与“多数一致”不能等同于数学有效性。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier math synthesis commonly rewrites human questions, conditions on examples, or assigns prompt-level difficulty labels. MathSmith instead uses concept-explanation records as the seed object and trains a problem-generating policy with explicit scalar objectives. The combination of concept traceability, a construction rationale, generator-side GRPO, and released HC/Hard synthesizers is the distinctive contribution.

The HC/Hard split also makes a useful design contrast. HC trades some pressure for long teacher traces against a binary consistency check, while Hard removes that check. The weakness-focused pipeline then reuses sampled_concept as an operational provenance field for targeted generation. This is stronger than publishing only final questions because it exposes a route from source concepts to variants.

The novelty should not be overstated. Concept recombination, teacher solutions, self-consistency, and difficulty prompting predate this work. Nor does starting from PlanetMath guarantee contamination-free questions: semantic overlap, copied definitions, and shared benchmark concepts remain possible. The advance is a comparatively open, reinforced generator recipe and artifact family, not formal verification or a complete data lineage system.

以往数学合成通常改写人工题目、依赖示例提示，或用模型给出的提示级标签控制难度。MathSmith 改用概念—解释记录作为种子对象，并用显式标量目标训练出题策略。概念可追溯字段、构造 rationale、生成器侧 GRPO，以及公开 HC/Hard 出题器的组合，是这项工作的主要特点。

HC/Hard 的区分也提供了有用对照。HC 在诱导更长教师轨迹的压力之外加入二值一致性检查；Hard 则删除该检查。弱点定向流程进一步把 sampled_concept 当作可操作的 provenance 字段，用于定向生成。这比只发布最终题目更完整，因为它暴露了从源概念到变体的路径。

其新颖性也不应被夸大。概念组合、教师解答、自一致性和难度提示都早于本文存在；从 PlanetMath 起步同样不能保证无污染，语义重叠、定义复用和共享基准概念仍可能出现。真正的推进是一个较开放的强化生成器配方和产物家族，而不是形式验证或完整的数据 lineage 系统。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
All three reward components can be gamed. Tag and step-count checks reward surface form. Trace length can reward rambling, failed search, or an ill-posed problem. Majority agreement from K samples of one teacher is correlated judgment and can converge on the same wrong answer; MathSmith-Hard removes even that signal. Boxed-string extraction does not establish symbolic equivalence, premise consistency, or proof validity.

The paper calls concept sampling contamination-resistant, but no released n-gram, semantic-similarity, or manual benchmark-overlap audit covers GSM8K, MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, or OlympiadBench. PlanetMath source URLs and immutable revisions are absent from the public record schema. A single train split, missing stable IDs, inconsistent viewer row estimates, and no joined rejection/reward log limit dataset accounting.

Reproducibility is also incomplete. The paper and current code differ on teacher sample count, rollout grouping, SFT epochs, and hardware configuration. GPT-4o/API snapshots, dates, random seeds, published-run Tmax and decoding settings are not pinned. The repositories and checked artifacts carry Apache-2.0 labels, but those labels do not independently settle rights for every PlanetMath-derived passage or generated output.

Finally, benchmark gains are model- and scale-dependent. The paper reports weaker effects for 1.7B/4B students and possible tradeoffs on easier problems. Performance cannot substitute for independent checks of correctness, diversity, licensing, contamination, or release completeness.

三个奖励分量都可能被策略利用。标签与步数检查只奖励表面结构；推理长度可能奖励冗长、失败搜索或病态题目；同一教师的 K 次多数一致是相关判断，可能共同收敛到错误答案，MathSmith-Hard 甚至删除了这一信号。基于 boxed 字符串的抽取也不能验证等价答案、前提一致性或证明有效性。

论文称概念采样具有抗污染性，但没有发布覆盖 GSM8K、MATH-500、AIME 2024/2025 或 OlympiadBench 的 n-gram、语义相似度或人工重叠审计。公开记录 schema 也没有 PlanetMath 源 URL 与不可变 revision。单一 train split、缺失稳定 ID、viewer 行数估计不一致以及没有联合的拒绝/奖励日志，都限制了数据核算。

复现条件也不完整。论文与当前代码在教师样本数、rollout 分组、SFT epoch 和硬件配置上存在差异；GPT-4o/API 快照、请求日期、随机种子、论文运行时 Tmax 和解码参数均未固定。仓库与所检查产物标为 Apache-2.0，但这些标签不能独立解决所有 PlanetMath 衍生文本或生成输出的权利问题。

最后，基准收益依赖模型与规模。论文报告 1.7B/4B 学生的收益较弱，并可能损害更容易的文字题性能。模型性能不能替代对正确性、多样性、许可、污染和发布完整性的独立检查。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the data-construction and open-release-recipes track, MathSmith is a useful end-to-end reference for separating source, generator, judge, and consumer objects. A reproduction can preserve PlanetMath page IDs and revisions; concept-explanation records; five-record sampling sets; policy candidates; rationale/problem spans; every structural, complexity, and consistency component; all K teacher solutions; extracted and normalized answers; rejection reasons; generator checkpoint; and the exact downstream subset.

The HC/Hard comparison is a ready-made verifier ablation. Curators can test whether consistency reduces malformed or ambiguous questions, whether trace length predicts independent human or symbolic difficulty, and where the two rewards select different records. Rejected candidates and non-majority teacher outputs are especially valuable audit data and should not be discarded.

The weakness-focused pipeline suggests a track-relevant use beyond generic scale-up: diagnose failures on a held-out Practice Set, trace each failure to its recorded concepts, generate controlled variants, and measure whether gains transfer without eroding easier capabilities. Before direct reuse, however, consumers should pin dataset revisions, create stable IDs and hashes, perform semantic decontamination and duplicate checks, run independent mathematical verification, and review upstream licenses. The open artifacts make those checks possible but do not replace them.

对“数据构造与开放发布配方”轨道而言，MathSmith 是区分 source、generator、judge 与 consumer 对象的完整参考。复现者应保留 PlanetMath 页面 ID 与 revision、概念—解释记录、五条采样集合、策略候选、rationale/problem 标签、每个结构/复杂度/一致性分量、全部 K 条教师解答、抽取与归一化答案、拒绝原因、生成器 checkpoint，以及精确下游子集。

HC/Hard 对照可直接用作 verifier 消融：检验一致性是否减少病态或歧义题目，轨迹长度是否能预测独立人工或符号难度，以及两种奖励分别选择了哪些记录。被拒绝候选和未形成多数的教师输出尤其适合作为审计数据，不应被丢弃。

弱点定向流程还给出一种不同于泛化扩量的轨道用途：在留出 Practice Set 上诊断失败，按记录的概念追溯每个失败，生成受控变体，再测量迁移收益是否以简单能力下降为代价。但在直接复用前，使用者仍需固定数据 revision，建立稳定 ID 与哈希，执行语义去污染和重复检查，开展独立数学验证，并审查上游许可。开放产物使这些工作可行，但不能替代它们。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the three data layers separate: concept summaries, problem/rationale records, and teacher solution records.
  • MathSmith-HC uses structure, trace-length complexity, and same-teacher consistency; MathSmith-Hard omits consistency.
  • Available Ratio means correctly formatted and teacher-solvable with a valid answer, not independently verified correctness.
  • The paper reports K=5 teacher samples, while the current reward code defaults to three; reproduce the paper from a pinned manifest, not defaults alone.
  • sampled_concept supports concept-level tracing, but it is not a stable source-page or cross-release identifier.
  • Treat long CoT as a proxy to audit, not a quality label; inspect ambiguity, guessed answers, and equivalent-answer parsing. Before training, pin revisions, reconcile row counts, hash files, check duplicates and semantic overlap, and review upstream rights.

• 区分三层数据对象：概念摘要、题目/rationale 记录、教师解答记录。
  • MathSmith-HC 使用结构、推理长度复杂度和同教师一致性；MathSmith-Hard 删除一致性项。
  • Available Ratio 指格式正确且教师可给出有效答案，不等于独立验证正确。
  • 论文报告 K=5 教师样本，而当前奖励代码默认 3；复现论文应依赖固定 manifest，不能只依赖当前默认值。
  • sampled_concept 支持概念级追踪，但不是稳定的源页面 ID 或跨发布 ID。
  • 长 CoT 是应被审计的代理指标，而不是质量标签；应检查歧义、猜测答案和等价答案解析。训练前还应固定 revision、核对行数、生成文件哈希、检查重复与语义重叠，并审查上游权利。

value.html: The problem releases store a sampled PlanetMath-derived concept set, a construction rationale, and one synthetic mathematics problem. The solution releases pair a problem with a Qwen3-30B-A3B solution trace and may also carry answer_dict, highest_freq, and sampled_concept fields.

Each generation input samples five records; the generator selects at least two compatible concepts and applies at least two of nine difficulty strategies.

value.html: Five sampled concept-explanation records, their broad categories, nine optional difficulty strategies, and format constraints for one unified, non-proof question with a numeric, symbolic, expression, or equation answer.

value.html: Offline text generation with vLLM, Qwen3-8B policy training using GRPO in verl, Qwen3-30B-A3B teacher inference, and downstream SFT with LLaMA-Factory. There is no proof assistant or independently executable mathematical environment.

value_zh.html: 用 vLLM 离线文本生成、在 verl 中用 GRPO 做 Qwen3-8B 策略训练、Qwen3-30B-A3B 教师推断，以及用 LLaMA-Factory 做下游 SFT。无证明助手或可独立执行的数学环境。

value.html: Format/step scores are programmatic. Complexity is normalized mean teacher CoT length. Consistency is a binary same-teacher majority signal. The downstream answer sampler extracts the final \boxed{} text and can retain majority groups.

value_zh.html: 格式/步分数是程序性的。复杂度是归一化的教师 CoT 长度均值。一致性是二元的同一教师多数信号。下游答案采样器提取最终 \boxed{} 文本并可保留多数组。

value.html: Structural reward weights format 0.7 and five-step compliance 0.3. Reasoning reward weights normalized teacher-trace length 0.7 and same-teacher answer consistency 0.3 for MathSmith-HC; MathSmith-Hard omits consistency. The total scalar is used by GRPO and is not an independent proof of correctness.

value_zh.html: 结构奖励对格式加权 0.7、五步符合 0.3。推理奖励对 MathSmith-HC 将归一化教师轨迹长度加权 0.7、同一教师答案一致性加权 0.3；MathSmith-Hard 省略一致性。总标量由 GRPO 使用，不是正确性的独立证明。

value.html: Generation emits one focused problem in the required tags. The paper's Available Ratio counts correctly formatted problems that the teacher can solve with a valid answer; exact normalization, invalid-answer handling, and independent correctness adjudication are incomplete.

value_zh.html: 生成在所需标签中发出一道聚焦问题。论文的 Available Ratio 计数教师能以有效答案求解的格式正确问题；精确归一化、无效答案处理与独立正确性裁决不完整。

value.html: Official code, processed concept records, HC/Hard synthesizers, problem datasets, HC short/long-CoT solution datasets, and downstream models are public. There is no single pinned release manifest connecting source pages, rejected candidates, rewards, solutions, and training subsets.

value_zh.html: 官方代码、处理后概念记录、HC/Hard 合成器、问题数据集、HC 短/长 CoT 解答数据集与下游模型是公开的。无单一固定发布清单连接源页面、被拒绝候选、奖励、解答与训练子集。

value.html: PlanetMath page -> GPT-4o concept summary -> five-concept prompt -> GPT-4o cold start -> Qwen3-8B SFT -> HC/Hard GRPO -> released problem/rationale -> optional Qwen3-30B-A3B solution -> downstream SFT or concept-targeted improvement.

value_zh.html: PlanetMath 页面 -> GPT-4o 概念摘要 -> 五概念提示 -> GPT-4o 冷启动 -> Qwen3-8B SFT -> HC/Hard GRPO -> 已发布问题/理由 -> 可选 Qwen3-30B-A3B 解答 -> 下游 SFT 或概念定向改进。

value.html: Qwen3-8B is the problem-generator base. Evaluation students include Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Qwen3 models from 1.7B to 32B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B under short- or long-CoT settings.

value.html: GPT-4o summarizes PlanetMath pages and creates about 8,000 cold-start records. Qwen3-30B-A3B estimates reward-time complexity and consistency, regenerates baseline solutions, and supplies released solution traces. Qwen2.5-32B appears in a solver ablation; Qwen2.5-Math-7B supports weakness-focused improvement.

value_zh.html: GPT-4o 摘要 PlanetMath 页面并创建约 8,000 条冷启动记录。Qwen3-30B-A3B 估计奖励时复杂度与一致性、重新生成基线解答，并提供已发布解答轨迹。Qwen2.5-32B 出现在求解器消融中；Qwen2.5-Math-7B 支持针对弱点的改进。

value.html: A LoRA-SFT Qwen3-8B policy writes a five-step construction rationale and one answer-focused problem from five sampled concept records and nine difficulty soft constraints. GRPO produces MathSmith-HC and MathSmith-Hard.

value_zh.html: LoRA-SFT 的 Qwen3-8B 策略从五条采样概念记录与九条难度软约束撰写五步构造理由与一道答案聚焦问题。GRPO 产生 MathSmith-HC 与 MathSmith-Hard。

value.html: Nine prompt-level difficulty strategies, five-step construction rationales, teacher solution sampling, GRPO, and a concept-tracing weakness-focused loop.

value.html: Structure plus teacher-proxy scalar reward during GRPO; downstream solution retention uses extracted boxed-answer frequency. Exact release thresholds vary by script and are not consolidated.

value_zh.html: GRPO 期间为结构外加教师代理标量奖励；下游解答保留使用提取的 boxed 答案频率。精确发布阈值因脚本而异且未汇总。

value.html: Remove non-concept PlanetMath entries; require at least two sampled concepts, at least two difficulty strategies, one unified non-proof problem, and a five-step construction rationale. HC optimizes structure, trace-length complexity, and consistency; Hard omits consistency. Solution-generation and weakness pipelines apply teacher-answer filtering, but full rejection logs are absent.

value_zh.html: 移除非概念 PlanetMath 条目；要求至少两个采样概念、至少两种难度策略、一道统一非证明问题与五步构造理由。HC 优化结构、轨迹长度复杂度与一致性；Hard 省略一致性。解答生成与弱点流水线应用教师答案过滤，但完整拒绝日志缺失。

value.html: The paper uses K=5 teacher traces for both complexity and consistency. The inspected reward code has MAX_GEN_TOKEN=32768, temperature 0.3, and three teacher samples, while published-run equivalence is unverified. Released short/long-CoT dataset cards say each stored solution is sampled once (n=1).

value_zh.html: 论文对复杂度与一致性均使用 K=5 条教师轨迹。所检查奖励代码有 MAX_GEN_TOKEN=32768、temperature 0.3 与三个教师样本，而已发表运行等价性未核验。已发布短/长 CoT 数据集卡片称每条存储解答采样一次（n=1）。

value.html: The paper reports LoRA rank 16 for five SFT epochs on 8 H100 GPUs, then GRPO in verl with 20 H100 GPUs and checkpoint selection at step 100. The current example scripts differ on GPU count and epoch count, so they are not treated as exact run manifests. Baseline SFT uses LLaMA-Factory for five epochs at learning rate 1e-5.

value_zh.html: 论文报告 LoRA rank 16，在 8 块 H100 GPU 上做五个 SFT epoch，然后在 verl 中用 20 块 H100 GPU 做 GRPO，并在第 100 步选择 checkpoint。当前示例脚本在 GPU 数量与 epoch 数上不同，因此不视为精确运行清单。基线 SFT 使用 LLaMA-Factory，五个 epoch，学习率 1e-5。

items: Longer teacher traces may measure verbosity, confusion, or failed search rather than intrinsic difficulty.
A majority from one teacher is correlated self-consistency, not an independent correctness proof.
MathSmith-Hard omits the consistency term entirely.
Boxed-string extraction can miss equivalent answers or agree on the same wrong form.
Available Ratio means formatted and teacher-solvable, not formally verified correctness.
更长教师轨迹可能度量冗长、困惑或失败搜索，而非内在难度。
来自同一教师的多数是相关自洽，而非独立正确性证明。
MathSmith-Hard 完全省略一致性项。
Boxed 字符串提取可能漏掉等价答案或在同一错误形式上一致。
Available Ratio 意为格式正确且教师可解，而非形式验证的正确性。
teacher-trace length is only a difficulty proxy
same-teacher majority can consistently endorse an incorrect or ambiguous problem
released solution previews include traces that notice inconsistencies yet still guess an answer
concept sourcing does not establish semantic decontamination
hard-problem specialization can hurt smaller models or easier word-problem performance
record-count displays and schemas differ across release surfaces
benchmark gains do not prove record correctness, licensing, diversity, or lineage completeness
